name: thermal
description: KOZMOS Thermal: a heatmap of the files this session touches. Reads, edits, writes and searches per file, a heat score that cools over time, grouped as a directory tree under the session folder: an indented heat tree on the terminal, a squarified treemap on the desktop, switchable by heat, reads or edits. /thermal toggles it.

autoOpen.title: Open on start
autoOpen.description: Open the Thermal sidebar when a session starts (where the layout docks panes).
